findings.title: Storage Layout Shift in SapienCore.sol
findings.description: Mapping inserted in middle of state variables shifts storage slots for all subsequent variables.
findings.impact: Protocol-wide configuration corruption on upgrade (treasury, fees, thresholds).
findings.recommendation: Move mapping to the end of state variable list before the gap.

findings.title: Validator Rewards Rounding to Zero
findings.description: Integer division rounds down, leading to zero rewards for validators in some configurations.
findings.impact: Breaks validator incentives; lack of participation.
findings.recommendation: Increase calculation precision or enforce minimum rewards.

findings.title: Liveness Griefing via Reveal Delay
findings.description: Malicious validators can withhold reveals to delay consensus finalization for days.
findings.impact: Protocol liveness degradation and delayed rewards.
findings.recommendation: Allow finalization on super-majority reveals before deadline.

findings.title: Validator Queue Monopoly by Whales
findings.description: Whales can fill the validation queue, excluding other participants.

findings.title: Reward Rate Manipulation (Sandwiching)
findings.description: Reward rate calculated at finalization allows manipulation via fundProject calls.
findings.impact: Value extraction and unfair reward distribution.
findings.recommendation: Snapshot reward rates at earlier lifecycle stages.

findings.title: Storage Gap Inconsistency in ValidationOracle.sol
findings.impact: Potential storage collisions in future versions.
